sn56.43:1.2: tattha yaṅkiñci cakkhunā rūpaṃ passati aniṭṭharūpaññeva passati no iṭṭharūpaṃ akantarūpaññeva passati no kantarūpaṃ amanāparūpaññeva passati no manāparūpaṃ
sn56.43:1.5: manasā dhammaṃ vijānāti aniṭṭharūpaññeva vijānāti no iṭṭharūpaṃ akantarūpaññeva vijānāti no kantarūpaṃ amanāparūpaññeva vijānāti no manāparūpanti.
sn56.43:2.1: evaṃ vutte aññataro bhikkhu bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn56.43:2.2: mahā vata so bhante pariḷāho sumahā vata so bhante pariḷāho
sn56.43:2.3: atthi nu kho bhante etamhā pariḷāhā añño pariḷāho mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.43:2.4: atthi kho bhikkhu etamhā pariḷāhā añño pariḷāho mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.43:3.1: katamo pana bhante etamhā pariḷāhā añño pariḷāho mahantataro ca bhayānakataro cāti.
sn56.43:3.2: ye hi keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti …pe…
sn56.43:3.3: ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ nappajānanti. te jātisaṃvattanikesu saṅkhāresu abhiramanti …pe…
sn56.43:3.5: abhisaṅkharitvā jātipariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti jarāpariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti maraṇapariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsapariḷāhenapi pariḍayhanti.
sn56.43:3.6: te na parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn56.43:4.1: ye ca kho keci bhikkhave samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ pajānanti.
sn56.43:4.4: anabhisaṅkharitvā jātipariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti jarāpariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti maraṇapariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti sokaparidevadukkhadomanassupāyāsapariḷāhenapi na pariḍayhanti.
sn56.43:4.5: te parimuccanti jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi
sn56.43:5.1: tasmā tiha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhanti yogo karaṇīyo …pe… ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yogo karaṇīyoti.
